ParkHere

 
 
 



Branding / Product Design / UI - UX @parkhere-app.de

ParkHere offers Smart High-Tech Solutions for Digital Parking Management. ParkHere Corporate is your assistant who makes the daily search for a free parking space in the company's own parking garage much easier. If available in your company, ParkHere Corporate provides you with reliable information about available charging stations for your electric car. For Android and iOS.
